command: set -e; mkdir -p /tmp/ispass2027-p0-update; gzip -dc /tmp/ispass2027-pathv3-spi.tar.gz | tar -xf - -C /tmp/ispass2027-p0-update; gzip -dc /tmp/ispass2027-p0-fw.bin.gz > /tmp/ispass2027-p0-update/fw_payload.bin; insmod /tmp/ispass2027-p0-update/spi-bitbang.ko; insmod /tmp/ispass2027-p0-update/spi-xilinx.ko; sd_wait=0; while ! test -b /dev/mmcblk0p1; do sd_wait=$((sd_wait+1)); test "$sd_wait" -lt 30; sleep 1; done; platform-sd-update --device /dev/mmcblk0p1 --image /tmp/ispass2027-p0-update/fw_payload.bin; sync
